subject.title: ignoreFileContent setting not working - file content still sent to model as context

question: Should Feishu gain a supported attachment-context opt-out, and what should the canonical option name, default, and top-level/per-account inheritance behavior be?
rationale: The reported key is not a current documented Feishu config contract, and implementing it would add plugin configuration behavior that changes what inbound media reaches the model.

options.title: Add Feishu Opt-Out
options.body: Add a documented Feishu media-ingestion option that defaults to current download behavior and suppresses downloads/model-facing media paths when disabled.

options.title: Use Shared Channel Policy
options.body: Create or reuse a broader channel attachment-ingestion setting if maintainers want one policy across multiple messaging plugins.

options.title: Document Unsupported Key
options.body: Document that Feishu currently supports size limits but no content-ignore switch, then close the request only if maintainers decide not to add this behavior.

recommendation.title: Add Feishu Opt-Out
recommendation.body: Add a documented Feishu media-ingestion option that defaults to current download behavior and suppresses downloads/model-facing media paths when disabled.
